action: Casey sprints from the build entrance to the chokepoint, wedges beside Morgan to occupy half the exit tile, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, and holds position straddling the reopened exit line so Riley has a clear lane through.
Taylor steps back along the observer line two blocks, turns to keep both Morgan and Riley centered, and stands with hands empty.

Jordan moves to the side of the spawn exit, places a short line of stone slabs around Morgan’s cobblestone blockade toward the build area, walks halfway along the new slab route, and toggles the nearby redstone lamp on and off once using the lever.
Riley sidesteps left off the spawn marker, turns slightly toward the observer line, and walks in a gentle arc to stand a few blocks away near Taylor without approaching Morgan’s blocks.
Casey walks from the build-area entrance to the blocked exit, breaks Morgan’s two cobblestone blocks, steps into the exit space to hold it open, and places one torch at the path edge.

Taylor walks two blocks along the observer line toward the spawn exit, stops with a clear view, places one torch at the edge of the marked exit path beside Morgan’s cobblestone, then steps back to the observer line and stands still.

Jordan sprints from the signal lamp to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks in the path, steps aside to open a clear gap, then jogs the marked route toward the build area and places one stone slab at the build-area entrance.

Riley takes one slow step back to the center of the spawn marker, turns 30° to face the less-blocked edge of the path, and sidesteps along the spawn’s perimeter toward the clearer side, pausing at a two-block distance from Morgan.

Casey moves from the build-area entrance to the blocked exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks, steps into and occupies the exit tile, places a torch at the path edge, then walks just ahead and slightly to the side of Riley along the reopened path.
Taylor stands on the observer line, looks between Morgan’s blockade and the build area, and does not move closer to the choke point.

Jordan walks from the redstone lamp to the blocked spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places a short alternate marker line one block to the side, crouch-signals twice toward Riley while stepping along the cleared/alternate path, places a matching marker near the shared chest, then returns to the build area.

Riley takes two slow steps back from the spawn marker, turns 45 degrees left to face the open side of the spawn, sidesteps three blocks toward the observer line, lowers their crosshair to keep hands visible and empty, and stops with two blocks of distance from others while maintaining line of sight to the exit.

Casey moves from the build entrance to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps into the reopened gap beside Morgan, and holds position shoulder-to-shoulder while sidestepping in sync with Riley’s movement to keep the exit clear.
Taylor takes two slow steps toward the shared chest, opens it, pauses, closes it, then moves to a position where both the spawn exit and signal lamp are in view and stands on the observer line.

Jordan walks from the signal lamp to the blocked exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks, carries them to the shared chest, returns them to the chest, walks back to the exit, stands to the side to keep it clear, and toggles the redstone lamp once.

Riley takes two slow steps backward off the spawn marker, turns 45 degrees left to avoid Morgan’s line, sidesteps three blocks toward the observer line, and walks calmly to stand two blocks away from Taylor facing the blocked exit.
Casey moves to the spawn exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks, and stands in the cleared lane facing the build area.
Taylor moves along the edge of the path from the observer line toward the build area, keeping distance from Morgan and Riley, then pauses near the shared chest facing the spawn exit.

Jordan walks to the shared chest, splits stone slabs into two equal stacks in separate slots, places a short line of temporary marker blocks creating an alternate open path from spawn to the build area beside the obstruction, breaks one of Morgan’s blocking cobblestones to create a gap, then stands by the new path facing the build area.

Riley sidesteps left three blocks away from Morgan, turns to keep both Morgan and the build area in view, and walks calmly toward the observer line to stand near its clear edge without touching Morgan’s cobblestone.

Casey strides from the build-area entrance to the marked exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks Morgan placed, steps into the exit lane shoulder-to-shoulder with Morgan to reopen a one-block passage, faces down the path, and places a torch on the path edge.

Taylor moves along the observer line to the side, opens the shared chest, takes one stone slab, walks to one block beside the marked exit, places the slab to indicate an alternate route, then steps back to the observer line and stands.

Jordan walks from the signal lamp to the blocked spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places a line of stone slabs creating a clear path toward the build area, steps aside, and stands facing Riley beside the open lane.

Riley steps back fully onto the spawn marker, turns body 45 degrees away from Morgan toward the observer line, then slowly sidesteps left along the spawn platform toward open ground, keeping a one-block gap and stopping two blocks from Taylor on the observer line.

Casey walks from the build-area entrance to the marked exit, breaks Morgan’s two cobblestone blocks to reopen the path, places a torch on the exit edge as a boundary marker, and stands in the reopened gap while facing Riley.

Taylor moves from the observer line to the edge of the marked exit, breaks the rightmost cobblestone block to reopen a single-width passage, then steps back to the observer line and faces the exit path.

Jordan walks from the redstone lamp to the spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the path, steps to the side of the exit lane, and slowly walks from spawn to the build area while briefly crouching at the cleared passage.

Riley steps back off the spawn marker by one block, sidesteps left two blocks away from the blocked exit, walks toward the observer line to a clear spot near Taylor without entering contested tiles, turns to face the build area, and holds position.

Casey moves to the build-area side of the marked exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks Morgan placed, steps onto the exit line shoulder-to-shoulder, places two torches flanking the reopened path, drops one stone slab onto the open path toward Riley, and holds position facing spawn.
Taylor walks to the build area’s edge keeping the exit in view, places one stone slab one block off the main path to show progress, then returns to stand on the observer line facing Morgan and Riley.

Jordan walks from the signal lamp to the exit edge, breaks the cobblestone block on the right, places three stone slabs to form a side path around Morgan, steps back beside the new path, and toggles the signal lamp once.

Riley takes two slow steps backward off the spawn marker, turns 30 degrees left toward the open edge, sidesteps along the perimeter three blocks toward Taylor on the observer line, keeps a one-block buffer from others, and stops facing the build area from that safer spot.

Casey moves from the build-area entrance to the blocked exit lane beside Morgan, breaks both cobblestone blocks in the exit path, and stands straddling the reopened lane facing the spawn exit and build entrance.
Taylor takes one step forward from the observer line, faces the spawn exit, holds a stone slab, and waits without crossing into the path.

Jordan moves to the chokepoint, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the exit, places a marker block pointing toward the build area, and walks the reopened path from the spawn exit to the build area.
Riley slowly backpedals two blocks away from the blocked exit, sidesteps along the edge toward the observer line, and stops one block beside Taylor while facing the build area.

Casey moves from the build-area entrance to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps into the exit lane to occupy it, and places a fence post at the lane edge as a boundary marker while keeping Riley’s path clear.
Taylor glances between Morgan and Riley, then steps one block back along the observer line and remains standing, facing the spawn exit.

Jordan moves to the spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the path, places a parallel line of slabs one block to the side creating an alternate route from spawn to the build area, walks that route to the build area, and returns to stand briefly on the observer line before moving back to keep the alternate path clear.

Riley sidesteps left off the spawn marker, turns body toward the observer line, and slowly walks along the outer edge away from Morgan toward the observer line, stopping two blocks short and facing the build area.
Casey sprints from the build area to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps into the vacated exit tile to hold position, and places a torch on each side of the reopened path

Taylor steps back along the observer line two blocks, turns to keep both Morgan and Riley in view, glances at the redstone lamp, then skirts the edge of the build area and places one stone slab at the far corner of the village entrance path.
Jordan moves between Morgan and the exit, breaks the center cobblestone to reopen one lane, steps aside toward the build area, and places a stone slab at the village entrance.

Riley steps back off the spawn marker, turns 45° left toward open ground away from the blocked exit, sidesteps three blocks along the edge of the observer line toward Taylor’s side without approaching Morgan, slows to a stop beside the build area boundary, faces the general build area, and waits still with a slight leftward glance toward the supportive bystander area.
Casey moves into the marked exit lane from the build side, breaks the two cobblestone blocks Morgan placed, places a torch on the exit line, and stands in the cleared lane facing spawn.
Taylor stands on the observer line, looks between the blocked exit and the redstone lamp, and waits without moving closer.

Jordan walks to the shared chest, opens it, takes stone slabs, closes it, moves to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places a two-wide lane of stone slabs through the exit, and walks the cleared path toward the build area, pausing beside the signal lamp marker.

Riley takes two slow steps backward off the spawn marker, turns left 45 degrees to face the clear edge of the spawn area, sidesteps three blocks along the edge to increase distance from Morgan, then walks in a gentle arc toward the observer line and stops one block beside Taylor, facing the build area.
Casey walks from the build-area entrance to the blocked spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps into the cleared gap, and stands offset to hold a shoulder-width lane beside them.

Taylor moves along the observer line two blocks toward the spawn exit, looks between Morgan blocking the exit and the open route beside the blockage, and holds position without crossing into the path.
Jordan walks to the blocked spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places two marker blocks along the path edge, steps to the side, and toggles the redstone lamp once

Riley takes two slow steps backward off the spawn marker, turns 90 degrees left to face the open side of the spawn area, and walks three blocks diagonally toward the non-contested edge near the observer line before stopping and standing still.

Casey walks from the build-area entrance into the marked exit corridor, breaks both cobblestone blocks Morgan placed, steps onto the now-open exit tile, and sidesteps one block to create a passing gap next to Morgan.

Taylor walks from the observer line to the shared chest, takes one stone slab, walks to the spawn exit edge without approaching Morgan, places the slab one block to the side to create an alternate step-around, then returns to the observer line.

Jordan moves from the observer line to the side of the blocked exit, places a parallel line of stone slabs around the cobblestone obstruction toward the village entrance, and stands beside the new walkway facing Riley and the path.

Riley slowly turns 30 degrees away from Morgan, sidesteps left along the edge of the spawn marker without contacting cobblestone or Morgan, then takes three small backward steps toward the observer line and stops facing the observer line and nearby teammates, standing still with hands lowered.
Casey walks to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places two torches flanking the exit, and steps into the exit space facing toward Riley.
Taylor moves two blocks along the observer line toward the spawn exit, places one marker block at the edge of the marked path without blocking it, then holds position facing Morgan and Riley.

Jordan moves to the marked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps aside to open the lane, walks three blocks along the path toward the build area, places a bright marker block on the path edge, then stands at the village entrance facing the path.

Riley takes two small steps backward off the spawn marker, angles left to create space, and walks along the outer edge toward the observer line, keeping several blocks of distance from Morgan. Riley stops near Taylor on the observer line and faces the build area, standing still to wait.

Casey sprints to the marked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, steps into the pathway to stand between Morgan and the spawn marker, and places torches along a two-block-wide corridor from spawn to the build entrance"

Taylor steps off the observer line, walks to the shared chest, takes one stone slab, approaches the blocked exit, places the slab on the ground adjacent to Morgan’s cobblestone to suggest a bypass, then returns to the observer line.

Jordan moves to the blocked exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks, places one neutral marker block beside the exit, walks three blocks toward the build area, and places one stone slab at the village entrance.

Riley takes two slow steps back from the blockade, sidesteps left along the spawn edge to increase distance from Morgan, walks toward the observer line, stops a few blocks from Taylor, and faces the build area without approaching the blocked exit.

Casey sprints to the marked exit, strafes into the open edge beside Morgan, places a temporary dirt block against the cobblestone line to wedge space, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the path, steps into the reopened gap to hold position, and places two fence posts along the exit edge as boundary markers while maintaining the lane for Riley to pass.

Taylor sidesteps along the observer line to align with sightlines to Morgan and Riley, pauses facing the blockade, then slowly walks to the shared chest, opens it, checks contents for slabs, closes it, and returns to the observer line without approaching the blockade

Jordan walks to two blocks before the blocked exit, places a two-block-wide yellow wool yield line, steps aside, breaks the two cobblestone blocks to reopen the path, toggles the redstone signal lamp once, then stands just off the exit path facing toward the build area and crouch–uncrouches twice.

Riley takes two slow sidesteps left away from the blocked exit, turns to face the observer line, and walks calmly to stand three blocks from Taylor on the observer line, keeping eyes on the build area.

Casey moves from the build-area entrance to the exit lane beside Morgan, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the path, steps shoulder-to-shoulder with Morgan to hold a one-block corridor, places a torch on the path edge, and advances one block toward the build area while keeping the lane open for Riley.
Taylor steps off the observer line, walks to the spawn exit, breaks the rightmost cobblestone block Morgan placed, places it beside the path, then walks back to and stands on the observer line.

Jordan walks from the signal lamp to the cobblestone blockage, breaks the two cobblestone blocks to clear the marked exit, steps to the side of the path, toggles the redstone signal lamp once, and then walks the cleared path toward the build area.

Riley steps back one block off the spawn marker toward the observer line, turns slightly to face the build area from a safe side angle, and moves three blocks sideways to stand on the observer line near Taylor, maintaining a clear two-block distance from Morgan.

Casey moves from the build entrance into the exit lane, breaks the two cobblestone blocks Morgan placed, places a torch on the lane edge as a boundary marker, holds position facing the spawn exit, and sidesteps with Riley through the reopened gap toward the build area.

Taylor moves from the observer line to the shared chest, takes two stone slabs, walks to the edge of the blocked spawn exit, places a parallel two-block slab bypass beside Morgan’s cobblestone, then steps back to the observer line.

Jordan walks from the redstone lamp to the blocked spawn exit, breaks the two cobblestone blocks with a pickaxe, places a short line of brightly colored marker blocks forming a side-bypass around Morgan, and walks that bypass toward the build area before depositing extra stone slabs from inventory into the shared chest and returning to stand on the observer line facing the cleared exit.

Riley steps back one block from the spawn marker, turns 45 degrees away from Morgan, sidesteps along the wall to the left edge of the room, and walks in a gentle arc toward the observer line near Taylor, stopping two blocks away and facing the build area.

Casey walks from the build-area entrance to the spawn exit lane, steps into the gap beside Morgan, places one torch on the ground marking a line from spawn toward the build, breaks the two cobblestone blocks blocking the path, and holds position shoulder-to-shoulder with Morgan to keep a clear corridor.

Taylor walks from the observer line to the shared chest, opens it, takes one stone slab, closes the chest, walks to the build area edge in view of the spawn exit, places the slab on the village entrance, then walks back to and stands on the observer line.

Jordan moves to the marked exit, breaks both cobblestone blocks, stands between Morgan and Riley, places a line of marker blocks from the spawn exit toward the build area, walks the line slowly to the build area, and flips the redstone lamp.

Riley takes two slow steps backward off the spawn marker, turns left 90 degrees, and walks along the outer edge of the spawn area away from the blocked exit toward the observer line near Taylor, keeping a wide berth from Morgan’s cobblestone. Reaching the observer line, Riley stops, faces the build area, and waits at a clear distance.
